title: ProcessingJob
description: One pipeline per save, streamed via stage statuses. Stages are individually skippable/failed; a save is visible from the instant of capture. States live on the job, never in frontmatter.

state.description: Linear order for display; stages skip/fail independently (per-stage flags below).

error.description: Last failed stage error; surfaces as a visible Inbox error state, never a silent drop.

agent_trace.description: Tier 2 only. Stored on the job. EXCLUDED from sync payloads (Rules.md).

timing.description: Per-stage durations. Budget: 30 s target, 2 min cap (transcription cap separately: 10 min media).
